subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback stay default-off behind a new channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback option, or run automatically whenever no media was extracted from text/html activity payloads?
rationale: Current main avoids noisy Graph lookups by requiring extracted attachment ids, but Teams can omit those ids for real uploaded files; the default changes operator cost, permissions expectations, and message-delivery behavior.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt a config-gated fallback and integrate it with the channel aadGroupId and reply-URL fixes so existing installs keep the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58617 protection unless operators opt in.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for all non-personal text/html activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only diagnostics.

options.title: Pause until candidates are reconciled
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers ask one fix path to cover channel aadGroupId, thread replies, and group-chat HTML payloads together.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt a config-gated fallback and integrate it with the channel aadGroupId and reply-URL fixes so existing installs keep the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58617 protection unless operators opt in.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent msteams and channel delivery history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility/default decision.
